exact.31-photo-iso6400: The direct and band-limited crops have the same smooth warm transition and dark vertical wire as the aligned control. The adjacent crenellated edges remain softer than the exact target.
exact.42-photo-iso6400: The regular fine structure under the diagonal survives faintly at the bottom. Its low contrast and smoothing match the aligned control.
exact.00-wire-iso6400: One wire direction remains faint on the mottled background. The GT crossings are clearer. The two additions leave the visible structure like the aligned control.
exact.04-wire-iso6400: The subdued diagonal traces above and below the soft horizontal edge remain weaker and less complete than GT in both arms.

standing.main-overcast-sky-main-overcast-sky: Smooth neutral gray with no visible added grain, repeating texture or new mottle in either head.
standing.main-building-detail-main-building-detai: Both arms retain the soft steel bracing and fine cables. ISO100 resolves more thin features.
standing.main-foliage-main-foliage: The leaf silhouettes and green tones follow the aligned control. Soft leaf subdivisions remain.
standing.main-chain-link-fence-main-chain-link-fe: The coarse crossing geometry stays coherent. The wire edges and highlights remain softer than ISO100.
standing.mesh-nominal-fine-green-mesh-left: The support bar and broad diagonals are recognizable, with the fine grid largely unresolved.
standing.mesh-nominal-fine-green-mesh-right: Subdued diagonal traces and diffuse background. Neither head visibly restores missing crossings.
standing.mesh-profile3879-fine-green-mesh-left: The transferred-profile traces are more visible than nominal and remain intermittent around stronger structures.
standing.mesh-profile3879-fine-green-mesh-right: One bright diagonal family remains clearest. The opposite direction has incomplete crossings compared with both ISO100 references.

exact.27-photo-iso6400: The bright leaves and lettering survive. The stone interior remains patchier and smoother than exact GT; any added surface detail is too faint to distinguish confidently.
exact.43-photo-iso6400: The blue area remains visually smooth and the smallest branch connections remain weak. The gain-floor result closely follows the parent across both regions.
exact.13-wire-iso6400: One wire direction is already faintly visible. The opposite direction and the GT crossings remain missing over much of the patch.
exact.17-wire-iso6400: A strong diagonal field survives. The central region still lacks the crossing family visible in GT. No obvious color shift or duplicate line was added.

standing.main-overcast-sky-main-overcast-sky: The gain-floor rendering remains smooth at native display. No visible repeating texture, color shift or new splotch.
standing.main-building-detail-main-building-detai: The bracing is recognizable, while the fine hanging lines and thin cables remain soft against the independent reference.
standing.main-foliage-main-foliage: Some residual correction is measurable; leaf separations and green tint look close to the aligned base. The reference still shows finer edges and structure.
standing.main-chain-link-fence-main-chain-link-fe: Coarse crossings stay coherent. A few faint line differences follow existing traces. No clearly restored crossing appears.
standing.mesh-nominal-fine-green-mesh-left: The support bar remains distinct and the fine mesh largely unresolved. Weak diagonal traces are very similar to the aligned control.
standing.mesh-nominal-fine-green-mesh-right: A few diagonal traces remain weak. The gain-floor crop shows no clear new crossing, false-colored lattice or new splotch.
standing.mesh-profile3879-fine-green-mesh-left: The transferred profile makes a direction visible, with intermittent crossings and fine detail lost near the frame. The gain floor gives no clear structural gain.
standing.mesh-profile3879-fine-green-mesh-right: The clearer diagonal family continues through part of the frame. The opposing family and crossings remain incomplete versus both ISO100 references.
